title: Model Context Protocol (MCP)
summary: An open standard that lets AI assistants plug into outside tools and data, so one connector works with many apps.

title: RAG (retrieval-augmented generation)
summary: A way to make an AI answer from your own documents by looking up the relevant bits first and handing them to the model.

title: AI agents
summary: An AI agent is a language model that works in a loop, choosing tools and taking steps on its own until a task is done.

title: Claude Code
summary: Anthropic's coding agent. It reads your project, edits files and runs commands from the terminal, your IDE or the browser.

title: OpenAI releases gpt-oss, its first open-weight models since GPT-2
summary: In August 2025 OpenAI published two open-weight reasoning models, gpt-oss-120b and gpt-oss-20b, free to download and run under Apache 2.0.
